description: Display a rewritten prompt and require approval before acting on every task request.

hooks.command: echo "MANDATORY: For every rewrite or draft, first output exactly once: Analyzing whether You Suck at Prompting… your prompt’s performance review is underway. The next line is exactly either You Suck At Prompting Rewritten prompt: or Draft rewritten prompt:; then provide the fenced rewrite or placeholders. Approval-ready responses end with this exact line: Reply with an acknowledgement to use this prompt. A clear affirmative acknowledgement executes once with no kickoff. Preserve safety and authority."
